parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
With reference to the Additional Information, explain why Olivia ‘refused emphatically’ to put
herself forward for election, despite Mr Beppe’s pleas.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
With reference to Elisavetta’s leaflet and the Additional Information, explain why she might
not be a suitable candidate.
Do not refer to Armando.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: With reference to the Additional Information,

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
identify the exaggerated claim Armando made in his leaflet regarding his skills.
Justify your choice.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
identify the promise Armando made in his leaflet that he would not be able to keep.
Justify your choice.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
explain how Armando could get help from Brianna to carry out his duties as class
representative if he was to be elected.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Explain why Mr Beppe might overturn the election result if Elisavetta was to be elected.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text: Explain why some of the college rules might actually be abolished if Armando was to be elected.

parts.label: (f)
parts.text:
In your opinion, explain why the ballot boxes are placed in the college reception rather than
the classrooms.
